content.introduction: The schedule of releases for Real Earnings from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) indicates that the release for October 2026 is scheduled for Nov. 10, 2026, at 08:30 AM. The BLS also lists releases for other months up to December 2026, including September 2026 on Oct. 14, 2026, at 08:30 AM. The Canadian Real Estate Association's schedule does not pertain to the U.S. BLS releases.
